Who We Are

A youth-led movement, not just an organisation

Project हम (Project Hum) is a youth-led social initiative founded on a simple belief: meaningful change begins with human connection. We focus on the small moments that leave lasting impact — an afternoon with children, a conversation with the elderly, a shared act of compassion.

Every drive we organise is designed not simply to provide support, but to build relationships and remind people that no one should feel forgotten. We are powered by young people who believe age is never a barrier to meaningful change, and that even the smallest acts of kindness can create a ripple effect.

Together, We Care.

How It Started

Our Story

Project हम was founded in 2026 by Reet S. Ghavri and Mehnoor Mahal, inspired by a shared belief that meaningful change begins with genuinely showing up for people — and that emotional well-being matters as much as material support.

Rather than waiting for the perfect opportunity, they began with what they had: an idea, a sense of responsibility, and the determination to bring together other young people who shared the same vision. What started small has grown into a youth-led movement driven by compassion, collaboration, and purposeful action.

The principle that shaped our beginning remains unchanged: impact isn't defined by the scale of an action, but by the intention behind it and the lives it touches.

Our Name

What does "हम" mean?

"हम" represents togetherness, responsibility, and collective impact.

We believe that even the smallest efforts, when carried out with unity and intent, can lead to something truly powerful.

What We Stand For

Vision, mission & values

Our Vision

A society where kindness is a way of life, and everyone feels seen, valued, and supported.

Our Mission

To inspire compassionate action through youth-led volunteering.

Our Values

Empathy, compassion, respect, integrity, inclusivity, and collaboration.

Our Purpose

To inspire kindness, foster real connection, and strengthen communities.

What We Do

Showing up, drive after drive

Right now, everything we do comes together in one place: our community drives. Small, consistent, and done properly.

Research The Need

Before each drive, the team studies the community we're visiting and what it actually needs.

Volunteer Contributions

Every drive is funded through the contributions of our volunteers and supporters.

Show Up, Consistently

Small enough to manage well, consistent enough to matter, drive after drive.

Spend Real Time

Conversations, painting stones, music, games — whatever helps people feel a little less alone.
